name: Concussion (Combat, Critical)
body:
Your critical hits can knock the sense out of your foe.

Benefit: When you score a critical hit with an attack, you can forgo dealing extra damage to instead deal 1d4 Wisdom damage. Weapons with a critical multiplier greater than x2 deal +1 ability damage for every additional multiple (thus a Concussion delivered with a greataxe deals 1d4+1 Wisdom damage).

Special: You can apply the effects of only one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
